title: Money columns are controlled by See Financial Data, not by View mode
custom_preconds:
1. User A has View mode Full View and See Financial Data OFF.
  2. User B has View mode Tech view and See Financial Data ON.
custom_steps:
1. User A opens a work order and looks at pricing columns.
  2. User B opens a work order and looks at parts pricing and labor rate fields.
custom_expected:
User A sees no money data (pricing is hidden everywhere).

User B sees parts pricing and totals (See Financial Data is on), but labor rate columns and fields are still hidden because Tech view hides them separately.
evidence: Needs live UI with two roles.
